content.title: Mission: 1 Million Barakah Passes
content.subtitle: A collective effort to sustain Muslims Day for a family of 10 million people
content.body:
Muslims Day is now a vast family of nearly 10 million people. Every morning, when the Fajr alarm rings on the phones of hundreds of thousands, or a reminder to send Durood or seek Istighfar appears for a moment amid a busy day, an app becomes more than just software; it becomes a living means of connection between a servant and their Lord.

We know that many of you were upset, frustrated, and expressed your concerns when reminders such as Durood and Istighfar were recently added to the premium features. We completely understand and sincerely respect your feelings. But the truth is, we had to make this difficult decision and introduce a subscription model simply to sustain the platform and continue providing these services.

At the same time, we understand that not everyone may be able to afford a premium subscription costing 100 taka per month. And we do not want anyone to miss out on these essential features because of financial limitations. That is why we introduced ‘Barakah Pass’. Through this initiative, anyone facing financial hardship can use all premium features completely free of charge.

Why This Initiative: 1 Million Barakah Passes by 2027

We do not want anyone to remain excluded from premium features simply because of financial difficulties. With this goal in mind, we have taken on an ambitious mission to provide at least 1 million brothers and sisters with free Barakah Passes by 2027.

Whether a student or a hardworking brother with a limited income, anyone who applies should be able to use these digital tools without hesitation, free from advertisements and interruptions. That is the heart of this initiative.

What Is Impossible Alone Becomes Possible Together

Providing free premium services to hundreds of thousands of users on a platform serving 10 million people, while continuing to cover monthly server bills and technical expenses, is impossible for a small organization like ours to bear alone.

This is where we call upon our brothers and sisters who have the means. Alongside taking premium subscriptions for yourselves, you can sponsor a Barakah Pass for one or more brothers or sisters according to your ability.

This is not simply about gifting a Barakah Pass. It is a collective effort to sustain this vast digital and Dawah initiative of the Ummah. In Sha Allah, the reward for every act of service made possible through your contribution will continue to be recorded in your book of deeds as Sadaqah Jariyah.

What’s Included in the Barakah Pass

Through your sponsored pass, a user will enjoy all Muslims Day premium features completely free:

  • Ad-Free Experience: A completely ad-free interface, allowing users to recite the Quran and make duas without unnecessary interruptions.

  • Durood & Istighfar Reminders: Amid the busyness of the day, users will receive around 60–70 reminders daily to send Durood and seek Istighfar.

  • Premium Tasbih, Qibla & Widgets: Modern tools to quickly check the Qibla, count Tasbih, and view prayer times directly from the screen.

  • Amal Tracker: A simple way to organize and keep track of daily obligatory and voluntary acts of worship.

footer_button.hint: In this busy age of technology, let us become a strong bridge connecting one believer to another through their acts of worship. Your small contribution can make another brother’s or sister’s daily journey of worship easier while helping sustain this vast Islamic and Dawah initiative for the Ummah. Join this noble journey toward earning the boundless pleasure of our Lord.
